newsitem.title: USA: Market Facts acquires NY marketing firm.
newsitem.headline: Market Facts acquires NY marketing firm.

text.p: Market Facts Inc said Friday it acquired BAIGlobal Inc., a market research and information company based in Tarrytown, N.Y., that had 1996 revenue of $12 million.
Market Facts said it expects this acquisition to add to its earnings.

Market Facts and BAIGlobal have worked together for the past seven years to market Mail Monitor and Inside Track, research products that are used by financial services institutions in the United States.
BAIGlobal will operate as an autonomous entity within Market Facts, under the direction of its current management team.
